about.description:
PowDroid is a battery consumption profiler tool for Android devices.

The project is developed and maintained by:
 - Olivier Le Goaër
 - Adel Noureddine

Previous contributors : 
 - Fares Bouaffar (initial author)
 - Pierre-Antoine Larguet
 - Alex Striedelmeyer
 - Julien Desprez
 - Nathan Lorit.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.content:
1. Connect your Android smartphone via USB

2. Enable USB debugging in developer options

3. Click 'START RECORDING' to start monitoring

4. Follow the on-screen instructions.
